page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance within the ecs.c7se Enhanced server family. Built on KVM hypervisor technology, this server utilizes the x86_64 architecture and features a dedicated 64-vCPU Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz.

The system provides 128.0 GB of memory, establishing a resource ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU core. This instance includes no local storage disks and no bundled GPU accelerators. Network connectivity features a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

By providing a low memory-to-vCPU ratio, the hardware configuration offers computational efficiency for processing-heavy workloads without requiring capacity for extra unneeded memory. Target workload fits include parallel batch processing, software compilation, computational modeling, and compute-bound enterprise services.
